# The Android app updates itself; tablet text size fixed
### New
- **The Android app updates itself (app 1.4.0 and 1.4.1).** If a newer app exists, the app menu (long press on the picture) shows "Install update to …", and the tablet check in Frameside offers **"Update app now"** for an outdated app. The tablet downloads the new file from GitHub and starts the installation; Android accepts only a file signed with the same key as the installed app and asks once "Update?". The first time you allow "Install apps" for the app once. After the update the app restarts by itself. There is no pop-up in the middle of the slideshow. Version 1.3.x cannot do this yet and must be updated by hand once.
- **The server configuration names the current app version** (`app_aktuell`); the app asks for it.
### Fixed
- **Android app 1.4.1: text and icons on tablets were still too small.** The frame page shrank itself to 1920 pixels wide for the TV app, and that rule also hit tablets. The app now reports whether it runs on a tablet; only TVs are shrunk.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
